svg.title: dsh-contract-renewal structure: one append-only contracts.jsonl, a write side that validates and appends, and a read side that turns days_left into four exclusive buckets and two exits
svg.desc: contracts.csv (7 fields) is validated by contract.ingest (R1) and appended to $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-contract-renewal/contracts.jsonl. On the read side days_left = end_date - as_of is computed in UTC day numbers and classified by four ordered tests with w = renewal_window_days and N = within_days (90): days_left < 0 gives expired, 0 <= days_left <= w gives in_renewal_window, w < days_left <= N gives expiring_soon, days_left > N is later and only counted. contract.upcoming returns the three groups plus counts; contract.report writes every row to exports/contracts-<as_of>.csv with sha256, rows and bytes.
